messages:
jordan: Hey team — Verdigris shared a security questionnaire and wants a 2-week POC using their verdigris-30b-v2 model. Key asks: private deployment (VPC), customer-managed KMS, use a quantized variant if possible, and latency target P95 <= 200ms. Can we run this on Dedicated or Private and what are the main blockers?

maria: @jordan we have a catalog entry for verdigris-30b-v2 but the quantized variant is labeled verdigris-30b-q8. Need to verify tokenizer compatibility (they use SentencePiece). Also: licensing? is this open checkpoint?

alex: Latency depends a lot on input length + batching. On Dedicated (A100/MIG pools) + no batching we can hit ~150-180ms P95 for 512 tokens. For Private/on-prem it'll depend on their infra (GPU model, nvlink). Recommend prefix caching and disable batching for interactive POC.

talia: Security side — KMS + customer keys supported in Private. We can enable zero-log option for the POC. I'll start filling the security questionnaire answers. @sam any commercial constraints? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: File uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/poCs/verdigris/security_questionnaire_verdigris.pdf (uploader: talia)

sam: Pricing summary: we can offer a POC credit package (2 weeks) and hosted trial OR a 1-month Dedicated trial with a short-term commitment. If they insist on Private deployment there will be a setup fee + support uplift. I'll draft numbers. Also note: q8 quantization reduces cost ~2.3x but may change quality slightly.

maria: Tokenizer check is required. They have a custom sentencepiece model; we have an adapter but need to run a quick tokenization equivalence test against our tokenizer. @alex can you run the sample check on staging?

alex: Running now. Command I used:
```
python infra/tools/token_check.py --model verdigris-30b-v2 --tokenizer-file samples/verdigris_sp.model --prompts samples/compat_prompts.json
```
Quick result: mismatch for 3 punctuation tokens (emoji + special spacer). I can patch the adapter to normalize those. Will push a fix and re-run.

jordan: Good catch. Legal also asked about data retention and audit logs for the POC — they prefer 0-day retention and KMS-managed keys. Is that doable for both Hosted and Private?

talia: Hosted: we can offer 0 retention for tokens and metadata for the POC on a per-customer flag (requires ops change). Private: easier, customer controls retention. I'll mark sec q Q12 answer as "private deployment with customer-managed KMS, minimal logs, SOC2 + attestation on request."

sam: Next steps checklist: 1) I'll send pricing + POC T&Cs; 2) @alex share tokenizer diff + perf numbers; 3) @maria confirm availability of q8 binary across Dedicated and Private builds; 4) talia complete security answers and send to customer.

maria: Confirmed: verdigris-30b-q8-triton build exists in our catalog but hasn't been validated on on-prem x86+NVLink images. I can run a smoke test on the Private image (ETA 48h). If that passes, we can produce a validated artifact for the POC.

alex: Perf note: when I re-run after tokenizer normalizations I'll attach P95 and cost-per-token numbers. Also propose we enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts to drop latency further.

jordan: Awesome — let's prioritize the tokenizer test and the security answers. I'll loop in the customer's infra lead for a short checklist sync tomorrow. Thanks all. :pray:
